text:
Ava: quick distill from 4 onboarding calls this week — repeating asks & churn signals
Sam: link please?
Ava: pasted top signals: 1) need 'env-scoped API keys' so teams can delegate access per project. 2) per-account model pinning UI (customers having to rely on support to lock a model). 3) billing attribution: customers want per-route cost export to match their internal chargebacks.
Diego: +1 on model pinning — it's blocking a mid-market deal. They asked for a rollback knob too.
Priya: examples from calls? short snippets?
Ava: one quote: "We can't show execs unpredictable model upgrades; need a pin + timeline." Another: "Our finance team needs CSV exports of per-route spend weekly."
Helen: can we surface these in the product board as separate triage tags? I'll own the ticket flow.
Sam: priority thought: pinning + billing export = P0 for renewal risk, env-keys = P1 for onboarding velocity.
Ava: agreed. Quick asks: (A) draft spec for model pin + rollback (owner: Diego), (B) billing export sample schema (owner: Helen), (C) small UX for env-scoped API keys (owner: Priya).
Diego: starting PRD today, ETA EOW. cc @cs-bot to add to onboarding playbook.
cs-bot: Added action items to #cs-actions board: model-pinning, billing-export, env-keys.
Priya: will mock up 2 UX options by Tue.
Sam: flag to Eng-Platform for feasibility on rollback semantics — Diego, want me to ping them?
Diego: pls ping, thanks.
Ava: thx team — I'll summarize for the weekly renewal sync and include verbatim call snippets. :thumbsup:
